intro.title: Intro
intro.why: Training background, pain or injury and goal. A painful area shows up as a caution in later tests; the goal sets the program direction.

airSquat.title: Air Squat
airSquat.command: Push your knees out, go down and up with control.
airSquat.why: Basic bodyweight squat: hip-knee alignment, ankle mobility and low-back control.

hipHinge.title: Hip Hinge
hipHinge.command: Send your hips back, bend your knees slightly.
hipHinge.why: Hinging from the hips: does the movement come from the back or the hips?

checks.hipsNotBack: Hips don't go back (bends at the knees)

overheadReach.title: Overhead Reach
overheadReach.command: Raise your arms overhead, keep your ribs down.
overheadReach.why: Reaching overhead: shoulder mobility and rib-cage / low-back control.

plank.title: Plank
plank.command: Brace your abs, keep your back still.
plank.why: Trunk endurance: do the back and hips stay still for 30 seconds?

gobletSquat.title: Goblet Squat
gobletSquat.command: Hold the dumbbell at your chest, lower with control.
gobletSquat.why: Loaded squat: depth, balance and knee-hip alignment.

pushUp.title: Push-Up
pushUp.command: Keep your body straight, bring your chest to the floor.
pushUp.why: Pushing strength and trunk control: how many reps, and when does form break?

dumbbellRow.title: Dumbbell Row
dumbbellRow.command: Pull your elbow toward your hip.
dumbbellRow.why: Pulling and back activation: do the shoulders shrug, is the back working?

conditioning.title: Conditioning test
conditioning.target: A: 500 m row / ski · B: 1 min burpees
conditioning.why: Conditioning level: time or reps, breathing and pace. With a watch connected, heart rate and 60-second recovery are measured too.

measurements.title: Measurements
measurements.why: Baseline measures: weight, waist and photos. Retests track change from here.

command.row500: Finish 500 meters as fast as you can, keep the pace.
command.burpee: Burpees for one minute: down, up, jump.

reason.start: First step: training background, pain and goal.
reason.hingeAfterSquatBack: The low back collapsed in the Air Squat — in the Hip Hinge, check whether the movement comes from the back or the hips.
reason.reachAfterHingeBack: The back rounded in the Hip Hinge — watch rib and low-back control in the overhead reach.
reason.plankAfterCoreFlags: There are low-back control findings — watch trunk stability closely in the Plank.
reason.gobletAfterKneeValgus: Knees caved in the Air Squat — check knee-hip alignment under load in the Goblet Squat.
reason.gobletAfterHeelLift: Heels lifted in the Air Squat — watch depth and heels in the Goblet Squat.
reason.pushUpAfterPlankSag: The back sagged in the Plank — watch for hip drop in the push-up, go to the knees if needed.
reason.rowAfterShouldersForward: Shoulders rolled forward in the Overhead Reach — check for shrugging in the Row.
reason.conditioningLowImpact: Knee / back pain reported — a 500 m row is suggested instead of jumping burpees.
reason.measurements: Last step: weight, waist and photos.
reason.result: All steps done — complete the result.

AIR_SQUAT.name: Air Squat
AIR_SQUAT.description: Feet shoulder-width; sit the hips back and down, knees tracking over the toes, drive up through the heels.

SQUAT.name: Squat
SQUAT.description: Basic squat: chest up, neutral spine, lower until the thighs approach parallel, then stand.

SUMO_SQUAT.name: Sumo Squat
SUMO_SQUAT.description: Wide stance, toes out; push the knees out and lower with an upright torso. Targets inner thighs and glutes.

GOBLET_SQUAT.name: Goblet Squat
GOBLET_SQUAT.description: Hold a dumbbell or kettlebell vertically at the chest; lower under control until the elbows pass inside the knees, drive up through the heels.

FRONT_SQUAT_WITH_DUMBBELL.name: Front Squat with Dumbbell
FRONT_SQUAT_WITH_DUMBBELL.description: Dumbbells racked on the shoulders; squat with an upright torso. Demands quads and trunk control.

BACK_SQUAT_WITH_BAR.name: Back Squat with Bar
BACK_SQUAT_WITH_BAR.description: Bar on the upper back; brace, lower under control and drive up. For experienced lifters.

BULGARIAN_SPLIT_SQUAT.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
BULGARIAN_SPLIT_SQUAT.description: Rear foot on a bench; lower vertically keeping the front knee over the toes. Single-leg strength and balance.

BACK_LUNGE.name: Back Lunge
BACK_LUNGE.description: Step back, lower until both knees are at 90°, push through the front heel to return. Knee-friendly.

FORWARD_LUNGE.name: Forward Lunge
FORWARD_LUNGE.description: Step forward, torso upright, lower without the front knee drifting past the toes, and return.

LATERAL_LUNGE.name: Lateral Lunge
LATERAL_LUNGE.description: Big step to the side; bend one leg while the other stays straight, hips back.

WALKING_LUNGE_WITH_MED_BALL.name: Walking Lunge with Med Ball
WALKING_LUNGE_WITH_MED_BALL.description: Walking lunges holding a med ball at the chest, step after step.

STEP_UP.name: Step-Up
STEP_UP.description: Place one foot on the box, drive through that heel to step up, lower under control. Knee-friendly single-leg strength.

SINGLE_LEG_SQUAT_WITH_STEP.name: Single Leg Squat with Step
SINGLE_LEG_SQUAT_WITH_STEP.description: Controlled single-leg squat off a step, free leg hanging. Advanced.

HIP_HINGE_DRILL.name: Hip Hinge Drill (Dowel)
HIP_HINGE_DRILL.description: Hold a dowel along the spine (head, upper back and tailbone touching); soften the knees, push the hips back and return without losing contact.

GOOD_MORNING.name: Good Morning
GOOD_MORNING.description: Hands behind the head; flat back, hinge forward from the hips until the hamstrings stretch, then return.

DUMBBELL_ROMANIAN_DEADLIFT.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
DUMBBELL_ROMANIAN_DEADLIFT.description: Dumbbells in front of the thighs; soft knees, push the hips back and lower the weights to mid-shin.

SINGLE_ARM_KETTLEBELL_DEADLIFT.name: Single Arm Kettlebell Deadlift
SINGLE_ARM_KETTLEBELL_DEADLIFT.description: Kettlebell in one hand; hinge and stand without twisting. Hip and trunk stability.

DEADLIFT_WITH_BAR.name: Deadlift with Bar
DEADLIFT_WITH_BAR.description: Bar over mid-foot; neutral back, push the floor away and keep the bar close. For experienced lifters.

HIP_BRIDGE.name: Hip Bridge
HIP_BRIDGE.description: Lying on your back, knees bent; squeeze the glutes and lift until shoulders, hips and knees line up.

HIP_THRUST_WITH_BENCH.name: Hip Thrust with Bench
HIP_THRUST_WITH_BENCH.description: Upper back on a bench; drive the hips up and squeeze for a second at the top. Strong glute work.

HIP_THRUST_WITH_BAR.name: Hip Thrust with Bar
HIP_THRUST_WITH_BAR.description: Barbell across the hips, back on a bench; loaded hip thrust.

CALF_RAISES.name: Calf Raises
CALF_RAISES.description: Rise onto the toes, pause at the top, lower slowly.

WALL_SIT.name: Wall Sit
WALL_SIT.description: Back against the wall, knees at 90°; hold the position.

CLAMSHELL_WITH_MINIBAND.name: Clamshell with Miniband
CLAMSHELL_WITH_MINIBAND.description: Side-lying with a mini band at the knees; keep the heels together and open the top knee.

SIDE_WALK_WITH_BAND.name: Side Walk with Band
SIDE_WALK_WITH_BAND.description: Band at the knees or ankles; step sideways in a half squat.

DONKEY_KICKS.name: Donkey Kicks
DONKEY_KICKS.description: On all fours; drive the bent leg up toward the ceiling without arching the back.

WALL_PUSH_UP.name: Wall Push Up
WALL_PUSH_UP.description: Hands on the wall; body straight, bring the chest to the wall. The easiest push-up.

INCLINE_PUSH_UP.name: Incline Push-Up
INCLINE_PUSH_UP.description: Hands on a bench or box; body straight, lower the chest to the edge. A step toward full push-ups.

NEGATIVE_PUSH_UP.name: Negative Push-Up
NEGATIVE_PUSH_UP.description: From the top of a push-up, lower slowly over 3–5 seconds; return from the knees.

PUSH_UP.name: Push-Up
PUSH_UP.description: Hands under the shoulders, body straight head to heels; lower the chest and press up.

PIKE_PUSH_UP.name: Pike Push-Up
PIKE_PUSH_UP.description: Hips high in an inverted V; lower the head between the hands. Shoulder-focused press.

DUMBBELL_CHEST_PRESS_WITH_BENCH.name: Dumbbell Chest Press with Bench
DUMBBELL_CHEST_PRESS_WITH_BENCH.description: Lying on a bench; press the dumbbells up from chest level and lower under control.

BENCH_PRESS_WITH_BAR.name: Bench Press with Bar
BENCH_PRESS_WITH_BAR.description: Barbell chest press with shoulder blades set on the bench. Use a spotter.

DUMBBELL_BENT_OVER_ROW.name: Dumbbell Bent Over Row
DUMBBELL_BENT_OVER_ROW.description: Hinge forward with a flat back; row the dumbbells by driving the elbows toward the hips.

KETTLEBELL_SEESAW_ROW.name: Kettlebell Seesaw Row
KETTLEBELL_SEESAW_ROW.description: Alternating rows with two kettlebells in a hinged position.

RENEGADE_ROW_WITH_DUMBBELL.name: Renegade Row with Dumbbell
RENEGADE_ROW_WITH_DUMBBELL.description: Plank on dumbbells; alternate rows without rotating the hips. Advanced.

SEATED_90_ROW_WITH_BAND.name: Seated 90° Row with Band
SEATED_90_ROW_WITH_BAND.description: Seated band row; draw the shoulder blades back and down.

BANDED_LAT_PULLDOWN.name: Banded Lat Pulldown
BANDED_LAT_PULLDOWN.description: Pull the band down toward the chest, elbows driving down to the sides.

BAND_ASSISTED_PULL_UP.name: Band-Assisted Pull-Up
BAND_ASSISTED_PULL_UP.description: Band looped on the bar under a foot or knee; pull the chest toward the bar.

DEAD_HANG.name: Dead Hang
DEAD_HANG.description: Hang from the bar with shoulders gently engaged. Grip and shoulder health.

BAND_PULL_APART.name: Band Pull Apart
BAND_PULL_APART.description: Pull the band apart at chest height, squeezing the shoulder blades together.

REVERSE_FLY.name: Reverse Fly
REVERSE_FLY.description: Hinged forward; raise light dumbbells out to the sides. Rear delts and upper back.

WALL_ANGEL.name: Wall Angel
WALL_ANGEL.description: Back and arms against the wall; slide the arms up and down without losing contact. For posture.

SHOULDER_PRESS.name: Shoulder Press
SHOULDER_PRESS.description: Press the dumbbells overhead from the shoulders; ribs down, no arching.

SHOULDER_LATERAL_RAISE_WITH_DUMBBELL.name: Shoulder Lateral Raise with Dumbbell
SHOULDER_LATERAL_RAISE_WITH_DUMBBELL.description: Raise the dumbbells out to shoulder height and lower slowly.

BICEPS_CURL.name: Biceps Curl
BICEPS_CURL.description: Elbows pinned to the sides; curl the dumbbells toward the shoulders.

TRICEPS_DIPS.name: Triceps Dips
TRICEPS_DIPS.description: Hands on a bench behind you; bend the elbows back to lower, then press up.

SINGLE_ARM_DUMBBELL_OVERHEAD_TRICEP_EXTE.name: Single Arm Dumbbell Overhead Tricep Extension
SINGLE_ARM_DUMBBELL_OVERHEAD_TRICEP_EXTE.description: Dumbbell overhead; keep the elbow still, lower behind the head and extend.

PLANK.name: Plank
PLANK.description: Forearms down, body straight head to heels; brace the abs, don't let the hips sag.

SIDE_PLANK.name: Side Plank
SIDE_PLANK.description: Prop up on one forearm; hold a straight line without the hips dropping.

CONTRALATERAL_DEADBUG_ONE_SIDE.name: Contralateral Deadbug One Side
CONTRALATERAL_DEADBUG_ONE_SIDE.description: On your back, arms and knees up; press the low back down and extend the opposite arm and leg.

BIRD_DOG.name: Bird Dog
BIRD_DOG.description: On all fours; reach the opposite arm and leg, keeping the back and hips still.

CRUNCH.name: Crunch
CRUNCH.description: On your back, knees bent; lift the shoulders and squeeze the abs.

SUPERMAN.name: Superman
SUPERMAN.description: Face down; lift arms and legs together slightly and hold briefly.

REVERSE_CRUNCH.name: Reverse Crunch
REVERSE_CRUNCH.description: On your back; curl the knees to the chest and lift the hips off the floor.

BICYCLE.name: Bicycle
BICYCLE.description: On your back; bring elbow to opposite knee, alternating like pedaling.

RUSSIAN_TWIST.name: Russian Twist
RUSSIAN_TWIST.description: Sit and lean back slightly; rotate the torso side to side.

MOUNTAIN_CLIMBER.name: Mountain Climber
MOUNTAIN_CLIMBER.description: From a push-up position, drive the knees to the chest quickly, alternating.

SHOULDER_TAPS.name: Shoulder Taps
SHOULDER_TAPS.description: In a high plank, tap the opposite shoulder without rocking the hips.

STAND_WOODCHOP.name: Standing Woodchop
STAND_WOODCHOP.description: Pull the band diagonally high to low, rotating through the torso, not the arms.

FARMER_CARRY.name: Farmer's Carry
FARMER_CARRY.description: Weights in both hands; walk tall with shoulders down and short steps.

OVERHEAD_CARRY_DUMBBELL_WALKING.name: Overhead Carry Dumbbell Walking
OVERHEAD_CARRY_DUMBBELL_WALKING.description: Dumbbell locked out overhead; walk with ribs down.

BEAR_CRAWL.name: Bear Crawl
BEAR_CRAWL.description: On all fours with knees just off the floor; crawl moving opposite hand and foot.

HOLLOW_BODY_HOLD.name: Hollow Body Hold
HOLLOW_BODY_HOLD.description: On your back; low back glued down, arms and legs extended and lifted. Hard.

LYING_DOUBLE_LEG_RAISE.name: Lying Double Leg Raise
LYING_DOUBLE_LEG_RAISE.description: On your back; raise and lower both legs without the low back lifting.

PLANK_TO_PUSH_UP.name: Plank to Push-Up
PLANK_TO_PUSH_UP.description: Move from forearm plank to hands one arm at a time and back.

PLANK_DUMBBELL_PULL_THROUGH.name: Plank Dumbbell Pull Through
PLANK_DUMBBELL_PULL_THROUGH.description: In a high plank, drag a dumbbell under the body side to side; hips still.

TURKISH_GET_UP_WITH_DUMBBELL.name: Turkish Get Up with Dumbbell
TURKISH_GET_UP_WITH_DUMBBELL.description: From lying to standing with the dumbbell held overhead throughout. Full-body control.

JUMPING_JACK.name: Jumping Jack
JUMPING_JACK.description: Jump while opening and closing arms and legs together.

HIGH_KNEE_RUN.name: High Knee Run
HIGH_KNEE_RUN.description: Run in place driving the knees to hip height, arms pumping.

ROW_ERG.name: Rowing Ergometer
ROW_ERG.description: Legs drive, then torso, then arms; reverse on the return. The tool of the 500 m test.

SKI_ERG.name: Ski Erg
SKI_ERG.description: Pull the handles down while hinging at the hips; rhythmic, powerful strokes.

BURPEE_WITHOUT_PUSH_UP.name: Burpee (No Push-Up)
BURPEE_WITHOUT_PUSH_UP.description: Squat, hands down, jump the feet back, bring them in and jump — no push-up.

JUMPING_SQUAT.name: Jumping Squat
JUMPING_SQUAT.description: Explode up from a squat, land softly and repeat.

KETTLEBELL_SWING.name: Kettlebell Swing
KETTLEBELL_SWING.description: Hinge and snap the hips to swing the kettlebell to chest height; don't lift with the arms.

FRONT_SQUAT_TO_SHOULDER_PRESS.name: Front Squat to Shoulder Press
FRONT_SQUAT_TO_SHOULDER_PRESS.description: Squat with dumbbells on the shoulders and press overhead as you stand (thruster).

BURPEE.name: Burpee
BURPEE.description: Squat, hands down, jump back, chest to the floor, jump in and leap up. The 1-minute test movement.

JUMP_LUNGE.name: Jump Lunge
JUMP_LUNGE.description: Jump and switch legs in a lunge; land softly.

DUMBBELL_HANG_POWER_CLEAN_AND_PUSH_PRESS.name: Dumbbell Hang Power Clean and Push Press
DUMBBELL_HANG_POWER_CLEAN_AND_PUSH_PRESS.description: Pull the dumbbells explosively from the thighs to the shoulders, then push-press overhead.

ARM_CIRCLE.name: Arm Circle
ARM_CIRCLE.description: Arms out; draw small to large circles forward and backward.

OVERHEAD_REACH.name: Overhead Reach
OVERHEAD_REACH.description: Raise the arms forward and overhead; keep the ribs down without arching the back.

CAT_CAMEL.name: Cat Camel
CAT_CAMEL.description: On all fours; slowly round and arch the back.

OPEN_BOOK.name: Open Book
OPEN_BOOK.description: Side-lying, knees bent; open the top arm behind you like a book, eyes following the hand.

QUADRUPED_THORACIC_ROTATION.name: Quadruped Thoracic Rotation
QUADRUPED_THORACIC_ROTATION.description: On all fours, one hand behind the head; rotate the elbow toward the ceiling.

THORACIC_EXTENSION_FOAM_ROLLER.name: Thoracic Extension (Foam Roller)
THORACIC_EXTENSION_FOAM_ROLLER.description: Foam roller under the upper back; support the head and extend back over it.

INCH_WORM.name: Inch Worm
INCH_WORM.description: Fold forward, walk the hands out to a plank, walk back and stand.

HAMSTRING_FLOW.name: Hamstring Flow
HAMSTRING_FLOW.description: Hinge to dynamically stretch the hamstrings.

HIP_FLEXOR_STRETCH.name: Hip Flexor Stretch
HIP_FLEXOR_STRETCH.description: Half-kneeling; squeeze the glute and shift forward to stretch the front of the hip.

HIP_90_90_FORWARD_REACHING.name: Hip 90/90 Forward Reaching
HIP_90_90_FORWARD_REACHING.description: Sit in 90/90 and reach forward with a tall torso.

WORLD_GREATEST_STRETCH.name: World's Greatest Stretch
WORLD_GREATEST_STRETCH.description: From a lunge, hands down, drop the elbow inside the foot, then rotate the arm to the ceiling.

CHILD_POSE_STRETCH.name: Child Pose Stretch
CHILD_POSE_STRETCH.description: Kneel, sit the hips to the heels, reach the arms forward and breathe.

DOWNWARD_TO_COBRA.name: Downward to Cobra
DOWNWARD_TO_COBRA.description: Flow from downward dog to cobra; spine and hamstring mobility.

PIGEON_HIP_ROTATOR_STRETCH.name: Pigeon Hip Rotator Stretch
PIGEON_HIP_ROTATOR_STRETCH.description: Pigeon pose to stretch the deep hip rotators of the front leg.

tests.title: Tests

protocol.title: First-session test program
protocol.description: Intro, movement, strength and conditioning tests, measurements; then a rating of four areas and the main thing to improve. After each step the next test is recommended.

tests.resultDescription: Core · Glute · Upper back · Conditioning: weak / fair / good (conditioning: low / fair / good). The app suggests from the findings; the coach decides. Then the main thing to improve is chosen and the program is written around it.

tab.createDescription: Get a program based on the evaluation, in the variation you want — by typing or speaking.

chat.placeholder: e.g. 3 days a week, upper-body focus, easy on the knees
